Role Summary




The MLOps Engineer will build and run components of the organisation's AI platform under the MLOps Lead: model-serving deployments on GPUs, AI gateway configuration, CI/CD pipelines with evaluation gates, the model registry, monitoring, and fine-tuning jobs.




Educational Qualification



B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML or a related discipline (Must have)
Certifications (desirable, not mandatory): CKA or CKAD, a cloud DevOps certification
Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work will be considered in lieu of formal qualification



Experience



3+ years in DevOps, platform or MLOps engineering (5+ years preferred); minimum 1 year deploying and operating ML or LLM models in production
Demonstrable deployment of at least one ML or LLM model to production by the candidate, with monitoring in place
Experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code and CI/CD
Experience with GPU workloads (drivers, CUDA, GPU Operator) is a strong plus
Experience serving LLMs with vLLM or SGLang is a plus



Key Responsibilities




Model Deployment & Serving

Deploy and scale models on Kubernetes with vLLM, SGLang or NVIDIA Triton across development, staging and production, managing versions, canary releases and rollback

CI/CD for AI

Build GitLab CE pipelines with tests, evaluation gates and adversarial-test gates; package models and services; deploy with Argo CD

Gateway & Registry Operations

Configure gateway routes, keys, quotas and fallbacks for self-hosted and external providers, and maintain model and prompt registry entries with provenance

Monitoring & Observability

Maintain dashboards, alerts and runbooks for latency, errors, GPU utilisation, token usage and cost, including LLM tracing

GPU & Training Jobs

Schedule fine-tuning and batch jobs on shared GPUs, and maintain drivers, base images and environments with the GPU infrastructure engineer

Security, Audit & Support

Manage secrets and access, pin dependencies and scan images, maintain deployment logs for audit, and take part in on-call and post-incident reviews



Technical Competencies



Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm; KServe or Ray Serve (desirable)
Serving: vLLM, SGLang or NVIDIA Triton; ONNX Runtime
Gateways: LiteLLM, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent
CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code: GitLab CE CI or GitHub Actions; Argo CD; Terraform or OpenTofu, Ansible
ML Lifecycle: MLflow, DVC
Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry; Langfuse or Arize Phoenix; NVIDIA DCGM
GPU: NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, GPU Operator
Security: HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao; Trivy or Grype; Cosign
Core: Python, Bash, YAML; Linux administration

CSQ326R35

Mission

The Machine Learning (ML) Practice team is a highly specialized customer-facing ML team at Databricks facing an increasing demand for Large Language Model (LLM)-based solutions

We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build, scale, and optimize ML pipelines, as well as put those pipelines into production

We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams

We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team

This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in LLMs, MLOps, and ML more broadly

This role can be remote

The Impact You Will Have

Develop LLM solutions on customer data such as RAG architectures on enterprise knowledge repos, querying structured data with natural language, and content generation

Build, scale, and optimize customer data science workloads and apply best in class MLOps to productionize these workloads across a variety of domains

Advise data teams on various data science such as architecture, tooling, and best practices

Present at conferences such as Data+AI Summit

Provide technical mentorship to the larger ML SME community in Databricks

Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to define priorities and influence the product roadmap

What we look for:

Experience building Generative AI applications, including RAG, agents, text2sql, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs, with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI

5+ years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging typical machine learning and data science tools including pandas, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow/PyTorch

Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP

Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc ) or equivalent practical experience

Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike

Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML

[Preferred] Experience working with Databricks & Apache Spark to process large-scale distributed datasets

About Databricks

Databricks is the data and AI company

More than 10,000 organizations worldwide ? including Comcast, CondNast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 ? rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI

Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark?, Delta Lake and MLflow
